Closes #3955

The Friends page tab row now wraps, so every tab stays inside the window. The add-friend and search fields use the theme's field style and are at least 44 px tall. "See all friends" no longer covers the Offline toggle, and the Offline heading is drawn the same in the drawer and on the page. This is CSS and test work only: no rule, ruling, engine or catalog change.

## What changed
- **Tab row** (`together.css`): `flex-wrap: wrap; overflow-x: visible;` on `.together-tablist`, so tabs.css's `overflow-x: auto` no longer hides the last tabs. I chose wrapping over scrolling with a fade because it needs no JavaScript and is always correct.
- **Fields:** a new `.together-field` class uses tokens only (`--hit-min`, `--bg-sunken`, `--line-bright`, `--radius-sm`, `--you`), so the CSS ratchets stay green. `AddFriend`'s input has it, and the search input is `together-field together-search`.
- **"See all friends"** (`.friends-panel__all`): now `inline-flex` with `min-height: var(--hit-min)`. At 44 px tall it draws no hit-area band over the Offline toggle.
- **Offline heading:**
  - `tavern.css`: `:not(.together-group__toggle)` added to the tavern button-size rule, with its comment updated.
  - `together.css`: `text-align: start` on the toggle.
  - The toggle keeps the heading's own face in both places.
- **Hit-area measure:** moved verbatim from spec 47 into `e2e/support/hitAreas.ts` and exported. Spec 47 now imports it, and its unused imports are gone. `FRIENDS_ALL` is added to `e2e/support/testids.ts`.
- **Tests** (`friends-screen.cy.tsx`): 7 new tests at each of the 7 menu sizes:
  - every tab is inside the window and the tab row doesn't scroll;
  - the add and search fields' style and height, on the page and in the drawer;
  - the hit-area measure on the watched controls, on the page and in the drawer;
  - the "See all friends" link doesn't overlap the Offline toggle;

- **Toggle selector:** it is `.together-group .together-group__toggle`, not `.together-group__toggle`. On the page, index.css's `.app-shell button` (padding, `font-weight: 550`) outweighed the plain class, and the new heading test caught it.

At every device size in #3726, every tab on the Friends page can be reached and reads as reachable: the row wraps, or scrolls with a visible cue such as a fade at the edge.
